messages.subject: Maritime Quarter, Bristol — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up yesterday. As discussed, the board has approved proceeding on Maritime Quarter at Brunswick Wharf in Bristol — the multi-let waterfront investment we've been tracking. Agreed price is £32.4m, NIY around 6.25%. Seller is Glennister Estates; their agents are circulating a data room link this week.

Can you send across your engagement terms and a fee estimate so we can get going? Isla Fournier will be your main day-to-day contact on the commercial side.

Daniel

messages.subject: RE: Maritime Quarter, Bristol — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter and terms of business are attached — fee estimate £58k–£72k plus VAT and disbursements, with SDLT of c.£1.61m on the £32.4m price. James Osei (senior associate) and Elena Marchetti will work with me; we'll codename this Project Harbor.

Please confirm source of completion funds when convenient, and ask Glennister's solicitors to send title and the data room link to James. We'll turn the report on title around quickly once we have the pack.

Kind regards
Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
